newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mondragon settles row, eyes more casinos.
newsitem.headline: Mondragon settles row, eyes more casinos.

text.p: Mondragon International Philippines Inc said on Monday it had settled its row with state-run Philipine Amusement and Gaming Corp (Pagcor) over the operation of its casino inside a freeport area.

Chairman Jose Antonio Gonzalez told the Philippine Stock Exchange that both parties agreed to form a monitoring team which would oversee the operation of the Mondragon-managed Mimosa Regency Casino to ensure that the terms of the contract were met.
The contract said the Mimosa Regency would cater mainly to foreigners and Filipino U.S. greencard holders.
The casino could admit Filipinos but was prevented from advertising or promoting it within the country.

Pagcor issued a closure order on Mimosa Regency in January saying it was enticing Filipinos to patronise the casino by granting limousine services, reimbursement of incidental travel expenses, free use of its hotel rooms and discounts on losses.

In his statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Gonzalez said Pagcor, the agency giving out the franchises, had agreed to allow Mondragon to open more casinos and expand the Mimosa facilities if no violation was detected by the monitoring team.
